programme.title: Messi: The Forgotten Tape
programme.desc: Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. In 2004, with the internet still in its infancy, it only belatedly dawned on Argentina that 16-year-old Lionel Messi, who had broken through at FC Barcelona, ​​was on his way to obtaining Spanish nationality. A VHS tape of Messi's highlights was made and delivered to the Argentina association to make him an Argentina international. – Documentary about the moment that would change the future of football. In 2004, it was only belatedly realized in Argentina that 16-year-old Lionel Messi, who had broken through at FC Barcelona, ​​was on his way to obtaining Spanish nationality. Sports, Football

programme.title: Life After Football: Footvolley 2026 Curaçao

programme.title: Eredivisie file. The Corner
programme.desc: S1E1. Dossier Eredivisie features the most beautiful moments from the rich history of the best competition in the world. The first episode focuses on the corner kick. What is the secret of a good corner kick and why does the home crowd always cheer while only 4 percent of all corner kicks result in a goal? With the help of analyst Arnold Bruggink, Eredivisie veterans Bryan Linssen and Jens Toornstra and corner specialist Nourdin Boukhari, Wouter looks for answers. – Dossier Eredivisie features the most beautiful moments from the rich history of the best competition in the world. The first episode focuses on the corner kick. What is the secret of a good corner? Sports, Football

programme.title: Eredivisie file. The Keeper
programme.desc: S1E2. Dossier Eredivisie features the most beautiful moments from the rich history of the best competition in the world. The second episode focuses on the goalkeeper. Are goalkeepers really a bit crazy? With the help of former goalkeeper Henk Timmer, Eredivisie veterans Bryan Linssen and Jens Toornstra and goalkeeper specialist Frans Hoek, Wouter looks for answers. – Dossier Eredivisie features the most beautiful moments from the rich history of the best competition in the world. The second episode focuses on the goalkeeper. Are goalkeepers really a bit crazy? Sports, Football

programme.title: Eredivisie file. The Header
programme.desc: S1E3. The third episode focuses on the header. No less than 15% of all goals in the Eredivisie are scored with the head. Of all ball contacts during a football match, on average 7.7% are with the head. This means that during 1 Eredivisie season no fewer than 28,000 heads are made. It has also been known for years that heading is not good for your health. It increases the risk of ALS, Parkinson's disease and dementia. – The third episode focuses on the header. No less than 15% of all goals in the Eredivisie are scored with the head. Of all ball contacts during a football match, on average 7.7% are with the head. Sports, Football

programme.title: Eredivisie file. The Dribble
programme.desc: S1E4. Dossier Eredivisie features the most beautiful moments from the rich history of the best competition in the world. The fourth episode focuses on the dribbling. Little is more beautiful in football than a successful dribble. But is there enough dribbling in the Eredivisie? Is there still room for adventure? Statistics show that in every Eredivisie match there is a dribble every 3 minutes. Who are the best dribblers? Where on the field is there most dribbling? – Dossier Eredivisie features the most beautiful moments from the rich history of the best competition in the world. The fourth episode focuses on the dribbling. Little is more beautiful in football than a successful dribble. Sports, Football

programme.title: Eredivisie file. The Free Kick
programme.desc: S1E5. The fifth episode focuses on the free kick. A successful free kick is the ultimate proof that your feet can do what your head wants. But in the Eredivisie there is less and less room to cheer after a direct free kick. At the beginning of this century there were regularly more than forty hits per season, but in recent years the number has not even exceeded fifteen. Where have the specialists such as Pierre van Hooijdonk and Lasse Schöne gone? – The fifth episode focuses on the free kick. A successful free kick is the ultimate proof that your feet can do what your head wants. But in the Eredivisie there is less and less room to cheer after a direct free kick. Sports, Football

programme.title: Eredivisie file. The Assistant
programme.desc: S1E6. The sixth episode focuses on the assist. Who gave the most assists in the Eredivisie? And who gave 4 in 1 match? In the past, the emphasis was almost exclusively on the goalscorer alone. Nowadays the assist is almost as valuable as the goal itself. Who are the best assist providers in the Eredivisie and where on the field are the most assists given? – The sixth episode focuses on the assist. Who gave the most assists in the Eredivisie? In the past, the emphasis was almost exclusively on the goalscorer alone. Nowadays the assist is almost as valuable as the goal itself. Sports, Football

programme.title: Eredivisie file. The Omhaal
programme.desc: S1E7. In the seventh episode the bicycle kick is central. Scoring with a bicycle kick is the best thing there is. A career as a goalscorer is not complete without a successful bicycle kick. Who are the bicycle kick specialists of the Eredivisie? And can everyone make a bicycle kick? Together with Jeremain Lens we will look for the answers and determine which bicycle kick is the most beautiful. – In the seventh episode the bicycle kick is central. Scoring with a bicycle kick is the best thing there is. A career as a goalscorer is not complete without a successful bicycle kick. Who are the bicycle kick specialists of the Eredivisie? Sports, Football

programme.title: Eredivisie file. The Penalty Kick
programme.desc: S1E8. The eighth episode focuses on the penalty kick. There is no action that is more controversial than the penalty. Whether it is right or wrong. How best to take it. And also who can best take it. It remains a one-on-one battle. Where mentality is at least as important as technology. Denny Landzaat took 25 penalties and scored 25 times in his Eredivisie career. With him we investigate what the perfect penalty is. – The eighth episode focuses on the penalty kick. There is no action that is more controversial than the penalty. Whether it is right or wrong. How best to take it. And also who can best take it. Sports, Football

programme.desc: Latin America is one of the most diverse areas in the world. The largest tropical forests, vast swamps and the longest mountain chain are located here. Each episode of the series is devoted to one region. It shows its natural environment, fauna and flora. In the heart of South America there is a vast, pristine space called the Pantanal plain. For part of the year, its area is flooded by a huge flood, with water levels exceeding five meters. In the following months, the area was hit by a great drought. Not only people have to cope with the vagaries of nature, animals also look for ways to survive. When the dry season comes, caimans gather where there is the most food, creating the largest concentration of these reptiles in the world. The Pantanal plain impresses with its rich fauna. They live here, among others: rare species of otters, jaguars and crocodiles. When heavy rains come and the area is covered with water, one of the largest waterfalls on Earth, Foz do Iguaco, comes to life in a breathtaking spectacle. Netherlands. 2012. documentary series

programme.title: 30 for 30: The House of Steinbrenner
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Day the Series Stopped
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

S1, Ep3 «Rooted»…In the misty and lush tropical forest surrounding South Africa's Soutpansberg Mountains, a 600-year-old outeniqua yellowwood tree reigns supreme. It's 115 feet tall, and a source of food and shelter for an array of plants and animals. Crowned eagles construct massive nests in her fold, and Samango monkeys take refuge in her branches. As if it wasn't unique enough, this ancient, endangered tree has no flowers, instead reproducing through male and female cones-a marvel of the natural world, and a true South African treasure | Documentary series examining the staggering wildlife activity on five of Africa's most iconic trees. Standing tall in often startlingly harsh environments, to survive as a tree in Africa requires much cunning. From the baobab's ability to store water, to the tricks of the sausage tree when seducing pollinators, this compelling series explores the thriving activity of each deeply rooted species, where birds, insects and other animals utilise their extraordinary features | Director: Dereck Joubert, Beverly Joubert | Cast: Fiona Ramsay

The ocean floor is littered with centuries' worth of vessels that met an unfortunate end and were dragged to the depths. programme.title: d/f Stories of kittens
programme.desc: A touching story about three adorable kittens who go on a journey around the world. From Japan to France, they explore their new homes, face different challenges and teach us the joy of discovery. Each of these cute creatures begins their journey in an unfamiliar environment. USA, 2015

programme.title: d/s Mysterious migration of red crabs. Silent Dwellers
programme.desc: Once a year, the coastline of Christmas Island turns into a carpet of bright crimson as millions of red crabs begin their amazing migration. This phenomenon has become one of nature's most fascinating mysteries and attracts the attention of researchers and tourists from all over the world. South Korea, 2020

programme.title: d/f Alamto – the country of reptiles
programme.desc: The western mountains of Iran are home to a unique spider-tailed viper - its tail imitates a spider, luring birds into a trap. From deserts to oak forests, only the fittest survive here: tree-climbing vipers, chameleon lizards and snakes that drink rain from their scales. For the first time, footage reveals the secrets of these rare reptiles teetering on the brink of survival.

programme.title: d/f Sunken Forest
programme.desc: Each subsequent release of the film will tell about the seasons when the water level in the Amazon reaches its maximum and rises to 28 meters. All land creatures rush to the hills in an attempt to escape the flood to higher places that the water cannot reach. 2016

programme.title: d/f Animal Games
programme.desc: Throughout the natural world, young animals spend most of their time playing. From cats who love the chase to chimpanzees who can solve puzzles. New research shows that play is at the heart of almost everything animals learn. The game is much more than just fun. It is fundamental to the development of the animal, and in some cases to its survival. Spain, 2023

programme.title: d/s Natural family ties. Conditions of engagement
programme.desc: Explore the fascinating ways animals find their perfect mate. Find out how creatures fall in love, create families, and decide to mate for the long haul. Then consider whether flirting is a skill that only humans can master. Dir.: Juan Luis Santos. Spain, 2022

programme.title: d/s Natural family ties. Good Parents' Guide
programme.desc: Think about the similarities between human and animal parenting, from birth to parenting. Discover smart baby protection strategies and experience what it's like when feral parents introduce their beloved offspring to the wider world. Dir.: Juan Luis Santos. Spain, 2022

programme.title: d/f Algeria from a bird's eye view. 1 p.
programme.desc: The eye of Arthus-Bertrand and his co-director Yazid Tizi allows us to discover this impressive country, endowed with exceptional cultural and natural riches. Dir.: Yann Arthus-Bertrand, Yazid Tizi. Ved.: Jalil Lesper. France, Algeria, 2015

programme.title: d/f Algeria from a bird's eye view. 2 s.
programme.desc: We return under the watchful eye of director Yann Arthus-Bertrand to see the lesser-known but richly undulating landscape of Algeria, bordering eastern Morocco. We follow the daily lives of people in all its remote corners. Dir.: Yann Arthus-Bertrand, Yazid Tizi. Ved.: Jalil Lesper. France, Algeria, 2015

programme.title: d/f Wild World of Magellan
programme.desc: On board a replica of the Victoria ship, we set off on a journey to the remote corners of the planet, which Magellan and his crew explored 500 years ago. This journey will take us to unique and hidden natural paradises where we can observe the behavior of animals adapted to life in these remote places. 2022

programme.title: d/f Life on the Rocks
programme.desc: The documentary dives into the world of mountain goats, known as the Lords of the Peaks. These incredibly resilient animals live in the harshest conditions and attract attention for their ability to survive in difficult situations. Study their habits and how they became the subject of legends and myths. The film will explore the challenges these animals face and what makes them symbols of endurance and strength. Spain, UK, 2020

programme.title: d/s Arsenal of animals. Spitting and stinging
programme.desc: While some animals need to use force to get food, others can kill the victim with one spit. Literally. Dir.: Bettina Dalton, Max Serio. USA, Czech Republic, 2016

programme.title: d/f Capricorn - lord of the mountains
programme.desc: Mountain goats were the subject of myths and legends in the ancient world, they were considered magical creatures, and therefore they were often victims of hunters. These amazing animals are the true rulers of the Alpine mountains, capable of surviving in the most difficult conditions. In this documentary we will learn all about mountain goats and their place in the ecosystem. France, 2017

programme.title: d/f Spain. Rabbit Land
programme.desc: More than two thousand years ago, the Roman Empire extended into the Iberian Peninsula, then known as Spain. This region got its name, which translated from Latin means “country of rabbits,” thanks to the huge number of these animals. But rabbits were only part of the amazing mosaic that made this Roman province unique. Spain, 2022

programme.title: d/f Whales and turtles. Return
programme.desc: After a long absence, whales and green turtles are returning to the coastal waters of the Reunion Islands. These mysterious animals left these places many years ago, but now, to the amazement of scientists, they have returned. We follow the story of a mother whale and her calf to understand what brought them here and how they adapt to their environment. France, 2020

programme.title: d/s Wild Italy: top predators. Italian bears
programme.desc: No one could bet on the outcome of the appearance of seven Slovenian bears, two males and five females, in the forests of Adamello in Trentino. Italy, 2018

programme.title: d/s Wild Italy: top predators. Two eagles
programme.desc: Two eagles fight to survive and produce offspring to preserve their species. Italy, 2018

programme.title: d/s History of the reef. Reef Rivals
programme.desc: A small corner of the Red Sea is home to one of the most stunning coral reefs on the planet. But this underwater kingdom has more than one ruler. 2018

programme.title: d/s Wild China. 1 p.
programme.desc: Guilin's fairytale hills and cormorant fishermen on the Li River form the basis of this journey through the colorful rice crops and strange creatures of Southern China. 2018

programme.title: d/f Marine Mammals: Champions of the Deep
programme.desc: The documentary explores the deep sea, the largest habitat on Earth. On this journey we explore both the shallows and the impressively deep, encountering rare animals and discovering their amazing adaptations that allow them to survive in the realm of the abyss. Find out how these creatures adapted to the extreme conditions of the underwater world and what secrets the sea depths hide. France, 2017

programme.title: d/s Wild Italy: along with volcanoes. 2 s.
programme.desc: The tallest active volcano in Europe and the most famous volcano in the world is located in Italy

programme.title: In the animal world. 30 s.
programme.desc: The fauna of our planet is vibrant and diverse, since the climatic conditions in different parts of it differ. Representatives of the fauna are forced to adapt to life in hot deserts, impenetrable jungles, centuries-old ice and ocean depths. How do animals, birds, fish, reptiles and insects hunt, reproduce and coexist in close proximity to humans? What habits are characteristic of different types of animals and how do they care for their offspring? An educational and exciting documentary project with fragments of the legendary show by Nikolai Drozdov. Great Britain, 2018, educational

programme.title: d/s Veterinarian Bondi Beach. 1 p.
programme.desc: Join charming and energetic Sydney veterinarian Chris Brown and his team as they treat animals in the Bondi Beach area with great care and professionalism. programme.desc: A biographical film about one of the most famous football players in the world, Cristiano Ronaldo. Before becoming a world football star, Cristiano had to go through many difficulties in his sports career. Like many, Ronaldo started out playing street football, running with friends through the streets of the small seaside town of Funchal in Portugal. Cristiano also played for an amateur team, where his talent was noticed by football selectors. From then on, Ronaldo's rapid rise as a football player began. He changed many famous clubs, became a repeated winner of the Ballon d'Or, won the Champions League and local championships, and finally became the most expensive football player in the world. programme.title: Deadly 60 – The most dangerous animals in the world
programme.desc: Steve is traveling in his home country of Great Britain. The naturalist tries to simulate the flight of an eagle in the wind tunnel. A little later he constructs a deadly spider web. (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: The film crew goes on an expedition in the Pacific off the coast of Costa Rica. There is Cocos Island, which is one of the country's national parks. Underwater, the crew encounters hammerhead sharks and, among other things, Rays.

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: The Socorro Volcanic Islands are a remote, uninhabited chain of islands 400 km south of Cabo San Lucas in the eastern Pacific. They are also often referred to as the Mexican Galapagos Islands. Here you can observe the breathtaking giant manta rays, whole schools of hammerhead sharks, dolphins and tiger sharks. (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: The Bahamas is surrounded by thriving coral reefs, underground caves and steep barrier reefs. All kinds of creatures cavort in the turquoise waters off the white sandy beaches: agile reef sharks, large whitetip sharks, manatees, sea turtles and wild dolphins. (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: Over 200 caves 40 km off Belize contain a variety of marine life and corals. This deep blue wilderness is home to rare fish, Myliobatidae, sharks and green moray eels. (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: Crystal clear water, steep reefs, dangerous caves and tunnels always attract divers to the island of Cozumel on the east coast of Mexico. The Caribbean is home to colorful schools of fish, bull sharks and giant sea turtles. (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: Off Roatán lies the second largest barrier reef in the world, one of the most popular diving areas. It is famous for black coral, deep-swimming nurse sharks and fearsome barracuda. (Station info).

programme.title: Big blue wilderness
programme.desc: Cabo Pulmo on the Gulf of California: Fishermen are revitalizing an ecosystem destroyed by overfishing. At the same time, they protect the area that Jacques Cousteau once called “the aquarium of the world.” (Station info).

programme.title: One earth – many worlds
programme.desc: Isolated from the sea, highly specialized species have developed on many islands. High-tech cameras get closer to Komodo dragons and document the fight between marine iguanas and Galápagos snakes. It becomes clear: external interventions quickly become an existential threat for animal islanders.

programme.title: One earth – many worlds
programme.desc: Deserts are among the most hostile areas on earth. To survive in this harsh environment, desert dwellers have developed some extraordinary strategies. (Station info).

programme.title: Our forests
programme.desc: Forests are much more than just a collection of beech or fir trees. They form a kind of superorganism whose parts are closely and diversely interconnected: roots and fungal threads run through the soil like a network of nerves. Forest air is permeated with chemical messages that trees exchange with each other. Researchers are only gradually beginning to decipher them.

programme.title: Expedition Germany
programme.desc: Geologist Colin Devey travels through northern Germany. It shows how ice ages, volcanoes, salt deposits and ancient mountains shaped coasts, low mountain ranges and cities and continue to shape our lives today. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Closed due to Corona: The perfect opportunity to walk through the zoo with the sea lion Charlie. In Sydney, veterinarians are trying to stop Bobo the langur monkey from becoming a father again. (Station info).

programme.title: Hautnah Zoo Visit
programme.desc: Facial tumors are decimating the Tasmanian devil population. Taronga Zoo is joining the global effort to breed cancer-free marsupials to save the species. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: Events come to a head in the British safari park: a lion matriarch is fighting for her life, keepers are fighting with cunning monkeys and the arrival of new hippos is under high pressure. (Station info).

programme.title: Animal Park: Zoo Stories from Longleat
programme.desc: The pressure is increasing in the zoo: hippos are returning after more than 50 years, the first reunions are causing risky situations and dramatic moments with lions, hyenas and crocodiles. (Station info).

programme.title: The great parks in Africa
programme.desc: Lots of animal species live in Addo National Park in South Africa: lions, leopards and elephants hunt through the wilderness - where even sharks and whales are part of the "Big Seven". (Station info).

programme.title: The African savannah – a unique habitat
programme.desc: In the savannah it's not just the law of the fittest. Between attacks there are moments of harmony and tenderness. Mothers protect their young and couples strengthen their bond. (Station info).

programme.title: The African wildlife – life and survival
programme.desc: What does everyday life look like for a pregnant giraffe mother? The camera reveals amazing things about how animals interact with other animals in their group or their susceptibility to predators. (Station info).

programme.title: Chimpanzees in the Congo with Jane Goodall
programme.desc: Excitement in the rescue center: Mbebo jumps over the fence of his enclosure and disappears. And 91 parrots arrive. But where should they all be housed? (Station info).

programme.title: Chimpanzees in the Congo with Jane Goodall
programme.desc: The sick chimpanzee baby John is flown to Tchimpounga for further treatment. The new addition to the parrots is causing a lot of work for the team. The birds are trying to get to freedom. (Station info).

programme.title: Champions of the animal world
programme.desc: Powerful forces of the animal world – from land to ocean: gorillas smash termite mounds, jaguars crack caiman skulls and orcas hunt through the seas as a team. (Station info).

programme.title: Champions of the animal world
programme.desc: Fast-paced hunts and deadly precision: Death adders strike with lightning speed, peregrine falcons swoop down to kill their prey, and gannets defy extreme forces while diving. (Station info).

programme.title: Crazy but true!
programme.desc: Encounters with the animal kingdom can be a borderline experience for us humans, be it an unexpected bird attack or a humpback whale weighing several tons that jumps out of the water. (Station info).

programme.title: Crazy but true!
programme.desc: On our planet, those who can best adapt to their environment survive. How do predators react when escape animals can see through their devious methods? (Station info).

programme.title: Deep Dive Australia
programme.desc: The tropical coastal area in northern Australia offers an ideal nursery for numerous marine creatures. The offspring of dolphins, dugongs and sharks find a safe home here. (Station info).

programme.title: The Atlantic: A Year in the Wilderness
programme.desc: With the beginning of spring, the Atlantic comes to life again. However, no resident has time to breathe deeply. In just a few months they have to find enough food and mate. (Station info).
